newsitem.title: USA: Security Capital has $155.9 mln under construction.
newsitem.headline: Security Capital has $155.9 mln under construction.

text.p: Security Capital Pacific Trust said Tuesday it has $155.9 million of new multifamily communities, or 2,459 units, under construction in the Pacific Northwest and Salt Lake City.

The company said it will develop another 1,250 units, representing $81.2 million, in Portland, Seattle and Salt Lake City by the end of the second quarter 1997, which it said would bring its total investment in these cities to $436.6 million, or 8,063 units.

The real estate operating company said it expects its investments in these cities to produce "strong growth in cash flow as the properties are completed and achieve stabilization." As of August 31, the company said, its

portfolio included 45,623 operating multifamily units, 6,909 units under construction and an estimated 8,173 units in planning. The company said it also owns land for the future development of 4,093 units.
